description: Register someone who promotes the merchant's offers for commission. The affiliate needs NO gocushy account: they're automatically emailed their referral links, rate, and a private Earn page (portal_url, also returned here) where they watch their own sales and payouts. Commission rate in basis points (2000 = 20%), settable per-affiliate here or per-offer on create_offer. Commissions accrue automatically on referred sales, hold for the refund window (default 30 days), then become due.

code.description: Referral code for links (?via=code); auto-generated if omitted

payout_note.description: How they get paid, e.g. their PayPal email

title: Create an affiliate
